text:
maria.h: quick async check-in — onboarded llama3-smallq v2 yesterday. After running the nightly evals I see a small but consistent drop on the Spanish summarization promptset (avg ROUGE-1 down ~1.8). Not sure if this is prompt normalization, kv-cache behavior, or quants. Posting eval id and promptset: evals/2026-0316-spanish-summary, promptset: ps/spanish-summary-v4. Logs I ran locally: `python tools/run_eval.py --eval_id evals/2026-0316-spanish-summary --model llama3-smallq:v2`

jon.p: saw the alert, thanks. Can you paste a quick sample pair (input -> v1 vs v2 output)? I can run a diff and check tokenization differences. Also can run the same eval with quant disabled locally.

maria.h: sure — sample (input truncated): "Resumen del artículo sobre energía renovable..."
- v1: "El informe destaca..."
- v2: "El documento subraya..."
Small wording shift but sometimes changes meaning. Eval output attached in the eval portal. Running a local with `--disable-quant-noise` now, will report back.

kevin.t: thanks for the heads up. I'll check infra changes — there was a micro-kernel tweak on the inference nodes late last night (softmax eps stabilization). If the difference is in logits ordering it could be that. Quick workaround to test: serve v2 with `--kernel-eps=1e-6` and see if outputs align with v1. If not, try `--disable-quant-noise` like jon suggested.

li.z: FYI I noticed a KV-cache warmup job ran across a subset of nodes (rollout tag kv-warmup-2026-03-16). If some requests hit cold cache vs warm cache we might see slight one-off diffs in short summaries. Recommend we A/B route 10% traffic to v1 variant for a day and compare metrics (ROUGE + user quality signal).

ana.s: also heads-up: I have a pending PR touching prompt normalizer that landed in the same deploy window — <https://github.com/redwood/pr/4823|PR4823>. If prompt normalization changed token boundaries slightly it could explain the drift. Jon, can you eyeball the normalizer diff when you run local tests?

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: kernel patch rollout starting at 1738884000 to inference-nodes-prod. Monitors will auto-rollback on >1.5% regression in pathway-llama3-smallq summary metric.

maria.h: thanks all — plan: (1) jon/kevin run local diffs with quant/no-quant + kernel-eps tweak (2) ana please flag PR4823 if normalizer is suspect (3) li initiate a 10% A/B to v1 for 24h and collect quick metrics. Blocker for me: can ops pause the kernel rollout if we confirm this is kernel-related? @ops (or ping infra). I'll post a short table with v1/v2 side-by-side results when ready.

jon.p: will post local diff by EOD Pacific.

kevin.t: I'll check node metrics and talk to infra; if needed we can gate the kernel roll. Also will run a small canary with `--kernel-eps` adjusted.

li.z: setting up the A/B now, tagging the experiment `ab/onboard-l3s-q2`. Will share dashboard link shortly.

maria.h: awesome — ping me if you need the raw promptset or eval snapshots. :raised_hands:
